record.Description: This recall involves CLC Lighted Portfolio & Johnson Level Digital Angle Locator, Digital Caliper and Building Calculator, with the model numbers located on the unit and the package labeling. The following models, UPC Codes and retail prices are included in this recall.
record.Title: Hultafors Group North America Recalls Lighted Portfolios, Angle Locators, Calipers and Calculators Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries
record.ConsumerContact: Hultafors Group North America toll-free at 877-722-7026 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at HultaforsGroup7307@sedgwick.com or online at www.HG2026.expertinquiry.com.

Manufacturers.Name: Hultafors Group North America, Inc., of Mequon, Wisconsin

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
The Johnson Level Digital Angle Locator, Digital Caliper and Building Calculator were sold at Lowe’s Home Improvement, Menards, W.W. Grainger, True Value Hardware and other hardware stores nationwide and online at Amazon.com from February 2023 through November 2026 between $64 and $400. The CLC Lighted Portfolio and Johnson Level 7” Digital Angle Locator and Ruler were sold at Lowe’s Home Improvement, Menards, W.W. Grainger, True Value Hardware and other hardware stores nationwide and online at Amazon.com from March 2024 through November 2026 between $45 and $55.

Hazards.Name: The various trade tools violate the mandatory safety standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because the button batteries can be accessed easily by children, posing an ingestion hazard. Additionally, the packaging and product do not have the warnings required under Reese’s Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.

Remedies.Name:
Consumers should stop using the recalled trade tools immediately, place them in an area inaccessible to children and contact Hultafors Group North America. To obtain a refund, consumers will be asked to upload a photograph of the product at  www.HG2026.expertinquiry.com and certify that the product has been disposed of and will no longer be used. Upon verification, consumers will receive the retail price, as shown in table below in the form of a virtual Visa gift card. The virtual Visa gift card may be redeemed at any establishment that accepts Visa.

Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.

ai.summary: Hultafors Group North America has recalled about 229,430 CLC Lighted Portfolios along with Johnson Level digital angle locators, calipers, and building calculators. These tools violate safety standards because young children can easily access the button cell batteries, and the packaging lacks required safety warnings. Swallowing these batteries can cause severe internal chemical burns, serious injury, or death.
ai.next_steps: Immediately stop using the tools and place them where children cannot reach them. Consumers should visit www.HG2026.expertinquiry.com to upload a photo of the product and certify that it has been disposed of and will not be used again to get a refund through a virtual Visa gift card. Dispose of or recycle the button cell batteries by following your local hazardous waste rules.
